sources.label: Morphe android app patches (for apps that I use) - stable releases
sources.author: bearinmind
patch_list: How far ahead, in metres, Waze warns of police, hazards, crashes, traffic jams and speed cameras. The defaults are the old Waze mods' (CGE); Waze's own are lower for most of them. They can be changed later in Customization, at the bottom o…
Every mood can be chosen: the ones Waze keeps for higher ranks and the beta moods it hides.

Bigger digits on the speedometer, and on the speed limit sign beside it, so they can be read at a glance. The sizes can be changed later in Customization, at the bottom of Waze's side menu, where a switch also gives Waze's own sizes back.
Sets the name shown under the launcher icon, in the app switcher and on Android Auto.
Waze's dark mode in true black for AMOLED screens: the app's dark backgrounds are black, and with Black night map the night map's background too. Roads, labels, buttons and text keep their colours.
Removes the sponsored pins on the map and on Android Auto, the full-screen ads shown while you are stopped, and the ad statistics Waze sends.

The old Waze mods' map skin, as changes to Waze's own: bigger map labels, a wider navigation arrow head and a warm day background. It is applied as Waze starts, and can be switched off or changed later in Customization, at the bottom of Wa…

How far ahead Android Auto gives its heads-up, and how long a jam must last before the traffic bar shows it. The defaults are the old Waze mods' (Chuppito). They can be changed later in Customization, at the bottom of Waze's side menu.
Turns off conversational reporting, Waze's Gemini voice assistant for reports, together with its activation dialog, tips and onboarding.
Keeps Google Assistant out of Waze: no Assistant button, onboarding or settings entry, whatever Waze's server enables for your region.
Turns on Waze's own switch for correcting the speed limit from the speedometer, the old mods' "Report speed limit". Waze's server keeps it off; what it shows is not verified here.

Hands the alerts Waze is tracking -- police, crashes, hazards, traffic jams, closures and speed cameras -- to Ungoogled Maps on the same phone, where Waze alerts in Waze & external data source puts them on the map. Nothing leaves the phone…
Speed camera sound at any speed
Plays the speed camera sound for every camera, not only when you are over the speed limit.
Turns speed camera and police alerts back on in the countries where Waze's server switches them off. Warning of speed cameras is against the law in some of those countries.
The style of the speed limit sign beside the speedometer, whatever the country. It can be changed later in Customization, at the bottom of Waze's side menu.

Lets Waze keep running in the background without a route for the chosen time -- Waze's server allows 10 minutes -- so that its alerts keep reaching Maps while you navigate there. Costs battery; Waze still closes itself when you close it. T…

sources.label: Morphe patches for Waze
sources.author: Forsigh Waze
patch_list: Choose how early alerts fire: Standard, Moderate, Heavier or Custom.
Runs Waze above 60 Hz, up to your screen's refresh rate.
Keeps your chosen auto-zoom mode from being reset.
Average-speed camera alerts, with the zone's recommended speed.
Scales the speedometer and the speed-limit sign.
Delivers police and hazard alerts as car notifications.
Stops the Play Store from updating Waze.
Turns on police and enforcement alerts.
Shows the map, alerts and ETA on the car's digital cluster, where it has one.
Stops Waze shutting down after you leave it.
Morphe YouTube Music as a Waze audio partner
Lets Morphe YouTube Music work as Waze's audio partner.
Plays the speed-camera sound even below the limit.
Turns on fixing the speed limit from the speedometer.
Shows cameras and road hazards on the map, with alerts.
Shows Waze's frames-per-second counter on the map.
Boots straight into the map as a guest.
Smoothes the car map's movement and heading on Android Auto.
Always shows the speed limit sign.
Warns when the speed limit drops.
Picks the sign beside the speedometer: US or World.
Pick any theme for the map - day and night.
Shows the traffic meter on the car screen.
Unlocks all moods already on the device.

sources.label: Morphe patch to use Waze with Gearslip
sources.author: waze-gearslip-patch
patch_list: Lets Gearslip, the Android Auto alternative, show Waze on the car screen. Waze's car library accepts only Android Auto itself on a phone; this adds Gearslip (and any other host you list) to the hosts it accepts. Android Auto keeps working…

Stops Waze from showing 0 km/h for a moment while driving on phones without Google Play services. A location without a speed gets one from the distance travelled, or keeps the last speed briefly, and short gaps between locations can be bri…

sources.label: Enables Androids default TTS engine
sources.author: Waze System TTS
patch_list: Use Android system TTS for navigation
Adds a system TTS control to Settings and replaces online navigation chunks using Android's default engine.

sources.label: Morphe patches for Waze, enabling integration and media controls for patched You
sources.author: Waze YT Music
patch_list: Waze shows speed camera alerts on screen, but plays the alert sound only when you drive above the speed limit. This patch plays the sound for every speed camera. Can be turned off in the Morphe patch settings.
Adds a button below the audio and sound buttons of the map. It opens the voice assistant of the device on top of Waze, so the map stays visible.
Adds "Morphe Patch Einstellungen" at the bottom of the Waze settings. It shows all applied Morphe patches with a switch to turn each of them on or off.

Adds a repackaged YouTube Music app (for example patched with Morphe) to the audio partners of Waze, so it can be selected and controlled from the Waze music player. The original YouTube Music app keeps working.
